g.text: CLOSE jumper to add I2C pullups to bus
When populating L1: use an 0603 part with impedance > 500 Ohms at 1.5GHz

USB Track Impedance: Differential Pair https://saturnpcb.com/saturn-pcb-toolkit/ Prepreg thickness: 0.2mm (7.1 mil). Er = 4.6 8 mil track with 5 mil gap (13 mil center to center) = 90 Ohms

RF Track Impedance: Coplanar Waveguide with Ground Calculations https://chemandy.com/calculators/coplanar-waveguide-with-ground-calculator.htm Ground is on layer 2. Prepreg thickness: 0.2mm. Er = 4.6 12.5 mil track with 5 mil gap = 50 Ohms
Cut track to disable VCC_RF antenna power
